evidence.quote: the Committee decided to continue purchasing additional agency mortgage-backed securities at a pace of $40 billion per month and longer-term Treasury securities at a pace of $45 billion per month
the Committee expects that a highly accommodative stance of monetary policy will remain appropriate for a considerable time after the asset purchase program ends and the economic recovery strengthens
Inflation has been running somewhat below the Committee's longer-run objective
The Committee continues to see downside risks to the economic outlook.
Labor market conditions have shown signs of improvement in recent months but the unemployment rate remains elevated.
